notes.title: Patch v1.1
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for your interest. After the feedbacks, we release our first patch (v1.1). [/b]

You can see the patch notes below.

1- Repair times of meteorites that damaged the ship were shortened.
2- Game lobby was designed from the beginning. He's much more stable now than he used to be.
3- Added new information and notifications to guide the players.
4- Some improvements were made within the spaceship. A much more stable gameplay was achieved.
5- The maximum number of electroshocks that can be received was reduced from 3 to 2.
